doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: First job with Tommy Turrentine, Booker Ervin and Rahsaan Roland Kirk
summary: His early experience came in Tommy Turrentine's band, with J.C. Moses, Booker Ervin and later Rahsaan Roland Kirk passing through.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What were your early playing experiences like, leading up to your experience with the Basie band.

Early on, yeah, well at first, my first job was with Tommy Turrentine, who is Stanley Turrentine’s older brother. And J.C. Moses was in the band, and Booker Ervin was in the band, he’d just got out of the Air Force and was on his way to the Big Apple, New York. And after that Rahsann Roland Kirk was coming through town on the way to New York so he joined this band, so I had a lot of early exposure, you know, early experiences.
